item.title: Brahma word torture
item.description:
विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)
  • mangalam
  • Intro - Saw how sentences are tortured - तत् त्वम् असि - https://youtu.be/2hhnJO4qD8s. Even words aren’t spared!
  • सत्यं ज्ञानम् अनन्तं ब्रह्म - जहल्-लक्षणा meaning निर्गुण-ब्रह्म (nirguNa-brahma) as per bellamkoNDa-rAmarAya in vedAnta-sangraha. प्रज्ञानम् ब्रह्म
  • Actual meaning - brahman has the qualities mentioned (is saguNa).
  • shAnkaran insist on discarding that direct meaning (as brahman is beyong qualities).
  • Equally then, brahman can be “indicated” by being said to be asatya (unreal), duHkha-maya (filled with sadness), ajnAna (ignorant) etc..
  • because some other rare shruti says “brahman is nirguNa”? Why not the other way round (twist just the word “nirguNa” rather than every other word)? 1k statements should win over 1.
  • Actually, nirguNa has several other apparent meanings - {tough, taste etc..}, {sattva, rajas, tamas}, … https://youtu.be/mujOCstJ97I
  • no lokAnuvAda excuse. Having only good but not bad qualities is not apparent from worldly observation.
  • violation of mImAMsA rules of textual interpretation.
  • A bad habit - Scandalous BG meaning - “माम् एकं (“अहमेवेत्येवं”) शरणं व्रज” = “न मत्तोऽन्यद् अस्ती"त्य् अवधारय! vAyka-lakShaNA.
  • Conclusion - a twisted, dishonest “philosophy”, violates mImAMsA and common sense.

item.title: Butchering mahAvAkyas
item.description:
shAnkara mahAvAkya (tat tvam asi) + mImAMsA butchery. Scripture fraud. Recognition & remembrence.

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

00:00 - mangalam
01:00 - Intro to mahAvAkyas. तत् त्वम् असि। अहम् ब्रह्मास्मि।
02:00 - Butchery of mImAMsA. Twist words per convenience - “Kill infidels”.
06:10 - Butchering तत् त्वम् असि। Literal meaning vs shAnkaran circus (discarding attributes).
10:10 - Justification with सोऽयं देवदत्तः in shAnkaran texts.
11:00 - अयं देवदत्तः - recognition
11:30 - सोऽयं देवदत्तः - remembrence + recognition (प्रत्यभिज्ञा)
12:55 - remembrence + Recognition = sAmAnAdhikaraNyam / co-location of attributes.
15:15 - shANkara misunderstanding/ misrepresentation - recognition of svarUpa minus attributes.
17:15 - Connection to tat tvam asi & attributeless / nirguNa brahman.
18:05 - remembrence + Recognition is not recognition of svarUpa minus attributes.
20:10 - remembrence + Recognition - attributes are important, cant be discarded.
24:25 - Objection - Opposite attributes can’t coexist. किञ्चिज्-ज्ञत्वम् vs सर्वज्ञत्वम्। गङ्गायां घोषः। Fix - attributes aren’t opposite.
27:12 - dharmAdhvarin’s vedAnta-paribhAShA (maNi-drAviDa-shAstri lectures - https://youtu.be/hbk2ARtYTxM) - hollow counter-traditional claim of there being no lakShaNA despite rejection of part of stated meaning. 36:50 - “Pot is impermanent”
38:30 - dharmAdhvarin claims that shAnkaran’s agreed they were resorting to “laxaNa” only for argument’s sake. 42:30 - Crypto-Buddhu justifications - “object is momentary”? “attributes are illusory. So can discard those.” Buddhists - “Underlying object is illusory, only attributes are real.” “Both are illusory.”
45:10 - Summary so far. 46:10 - तत् त्वम् असि। sAmAnAdhikaraNya intended. तत्, त्वम् are with attributes only. Removing attributes = twisting words.
47:20 - Context of tat tvam asi. स य एषोऽणिमा। ऐतदात्म्यम् इदं सर्वम्। Atma of everything. sharIrAtma-bhAva.
50:20 - No justification - attributes aren’t opposite - sharIra-sharIri-bhAva. stated in same context - ऐतद्-आत्म्यम् इदं सर्वम्।
52:00 - “You” can refer to brahman/ paramAtmA within you. All words can refer to the body, Atma, paramAtma. अहं रोगी। अहं जानामि। अहं ब्रह्म। Verb decides meaning.
59:30 - Fabricated scriptures - शुकरहस्योपनिषत्। 01:03:30 - रामगीता। 01:05:50 - Then accept mAdhva मठरश्रुति, garuDa-purANa 3 etc..
01:07:30 - सर्वं खल्व् इदम् ब्रह्म।
01:08:10 - अहम् ब्रह्मास्मि। extra flaw - अहम् for advaitins is not AtmA but ahankAra. So the sage who experienced this was not shAnkara.
01:09:35 - Conclusion - Dishonesty - first do poor mImAMsA, then twist the mechanism of remembrence & recognition. Illogic. Then fabricate scriptures for overriding common-sense mImAMsA. 01:11:54 - Acknowledgement.

item.title: chakkilam venkaTesh

00:45 - Intro - Define paraphrase. 01:25 - Fake brahma-sUtra quotation - can one paraphrase “उत्पत्त्यसम्भवात् ॥ ४२ ॥ " as “पाञ्चरात्रं तु केचित्”? 03:15 - can one paraphrase “न च कर्तुः करणम् ॥ ४३ ॥” as “असमञ्जसम्, अविरोधाच्च”? 04:30 - Ask AI. (bing copilot, gemini, claude.) 05:45 - ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पितृभ्यश् च मुखम् एतत् तु दानजम् । दत्त-दानस् तु विषुवे कृत-कृत्योऽभिजायते ॥७९॥ can’t be paraphrased as वैष्णवः परमो लोको वैकुण्ठाख्यः सनातनः । सप्तलोक इति प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मणः पदमुत्तमम् ॥ 08:45 - Not paraphrases. See https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=svZ0M70VufM . Many other errors - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL63uIhJxWbgiP8kds9zRvepT_Wtx-soVA 14:00 - aham-brahmAsmi foundation of shRngerI shAradA pITha considers him qualified to teach 6 darshana-s? 15:50 - Question to followers of chakkulam 16:30 - Context behind video - traumatized by being exposed as a fraud; he dragged my name in an unrelated conversation.

item.title: upaniShat fabrication
item.description:
shAnkara upaniShat forgery - 108 list, long advaitin tradition of fraud caught, motivation analyzed.

Source: TW

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

00:00 - mangalam 00:40 - Intro - shANkaran forgery enterpise - upaniShat factory. 02:55 - Eg. v Subramanian’s adbhutam blog on nirAlambopaniShat etc. 03:45 - Purpose of fabrication. rajju-sarpa (rope-snake analogy), resoring to laxaNa meaning for understanding mahAvAkya-s (shukarahasyaopaniShat?). 07:45 - muktikA / muktikopaniShat list of 108 upaniShats fabricated 09:15 - Objections 10:00 - No citation 10:40 - allopaniShat etc. Mutual contradictions, corruptions. 11:30 - No mention in dArA shikoh’s persian translation list. 12:30 - No quote by shAnkaran debaters (appayya dIxita or madhusUdana sarasvsatI), or by mAdhvas (vijayIndra). 13:40 - Omits legitimate pAramAtmika upaniShat 14:15 - Overview 14:50 - purANa-like style 15:40 - Why 108? 16:00 - Quotes from muktikopaniShat? No! 21:00 - Old shANkaran Commentaries agree. 21:20 - shankara doesn’t cite kaTha-rudropaniShat. 22:45 - No 108-upaniShat list in medieval times. (vedAnta deshika on mahopaniShat could’ve used muktikA if it existed.) 25:00 - Expected mahopaniShat quotes as per shAnkara-s like vaidyanAtha dIxita. 26:15 - tejo-bindu upaniShat 26:40 - shAnkara forgery tradition - note by venkaTanAtha vedAnta deshika 29:05 - shankara as upaniShad author! maThAmnAyopaniShat. AtmaShaTkopaniShat. advaitabhAvanopaniShat. 31:20 - Verses copied from vivekachUDAmaNi. 33:00 - vaiShNavopaniShats are not admissible shruti 33:45 - Conclusion.
